poets.name: Mirza Ghalib
poets.about: Delhi's most celebrated Urdu and Persian poet. Known for deep thoughts, wit and a very personal voice.

poets.name: Mir Taqi Mir
poets.about: Called the 'god of poetry'. His simple words and sad, tender feeling shaped the Urdu ghazal.

poets.name: Allama Iqbal
poets.about: Poet-philosopher who wrote about self-belief ('khudi'), effort and hope. Wrote 'Saare Jahan Se Achha'.

poets.name: Faiz Ahmed Faiz
poets.about: Mixed love poetry with the dream of a fairer world. One of the most loved poets of the 20th century.

poets.name: Ahmad Faraz
poets.about: Pakistani poet famous for easy, romantic ghazals that people sing and quote.

poets.name: Parveen Shakir
poets.about: Pakistani poet who gave a fresh, honest voice to a woman's feelings in Urdu poetry.

poets.name: Jaun Elia
poets.about: Born in Amroha. Known for blunt, ironic and deeply honest lines about love and loneliness.

poets.name: Rahat Indori
poets.about: Mushaira star and film lyricist from Indore, loved for his bold, powerful delivery.

poets.name: Gulzar
poets.about: Poet, lyricist and film-maker. Famous for soft images and simple everyday words.

poets.name: Kabir
poets.about: Saint-poet whose two-line 'dohe' teach honesty, humility and kindness in plain language.

poets.name: Bashir Badr
poets.about: Writes ghazals in light, everyday language, which is why so many couplets are quoted by ordinary people.

poets.name: Dagh Dehlvi
poets.about: Master of the playful, graceful Delhi style, famous for the way he used everyday speech.

poets.name: Nida Fazli
poets.about: Poet and lyricist known for short, simple lines that carry big ideas about life.

poets.name: Abdul Rahim Khan-i-Khanan
poets.about: Poet and minister at Emperor Akbar's court, loved for his short, wise dohas about friendship, love and conduct.

sher.hi:
हज़ारों ख़्वाहिशें ऐसी कि हर ख़्वाहिश पे दम निकले
बहुत निकले मिरे अरमान लेकिन फिर भी कम निकले
sher.roman:
Hazaaron khwaahishen aisi ki har khwaahish pe dam nikle
Bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle
sher.en: I have thousands of wishes, each so strong that I could die for it. Many of my desires came true, yet they were still too few.

sher.hi:
हम को मालूम है जन्नत की हक़ीक़त लेकिन
दिल के ख़ुश रखने को 'ग़ालिब' ये ख़याल अच्छा है
sher.roman:
Hum ko maaloom hai jannat ki haqeeqat lekin
Dil ke khush rakhne ko 'Ghalib' ye khayaal achha hai
sher.en: I know the reality of heaven, but to keep the heart happy, Ghalib, it is a nice thought.

sher.hi:
इश्क़ ने 'ग़ालिब' निकम्मा कर दिया
वर्ना हम भी आदमी थे काम के
sher.roman:
Ishq ne 'Ghalib' nikamma kar diya
Varna hum bhi aadmi the kaam ke
sher.en: Love has made me useless, Ghalib; otherwise I too was a man of some worth.

sher.hi:
दिल-ए-नादाँ तुझे हुआ क्या है
आख़िर इस दर्द की दवा क्या है
sher.roman:
Dil-e-naadaan tujhe hua kya hai
Aakhir is dard ki dawa kya hai
sher.en: O innocent heart, what has happened to you? What, after all, is the cure for this pain?

sher.hi:
रगों में दौड़ते फिरने के हम नहीं क़ाइल
जब आँख ही से न टपका तो फिर लहू क्या है
sher.roman:
Ragon mein daudte phirne ke hum nahin qaail
Jab aankh hi se na tapka to phir lahoo kya hai
sher.en: I am not impressed by blood that only runs through the veins. If it does not drip from the eye, what is it worth?

sher.hi:
उन के देखे से जो आ जाती है मुँह पर रौनक़
वो समझते हैं कि बीमार का हाल अच्छा है
sher.roman:
Un ke dekhe se jo aa jaati hai munh par raunaq
Woh samajhte hain ke beemaar ka haal achha hai
sher.en: When my beloved looks at me, my face lights up, and so they think the patient is doing well.

sher.hi:
पत्ता पत्ता बूटा बूटा हाल हमारा जाने है
जाने न जाने गुल ही न जाने बाग़ तो सारा जाने है
sher.roman:
Patta patta boota boota haal hamaara jaane hai
Jaane na jaane gul hi na jaane baagh to saara jaane hai
sher.en: Every leaf and every plant knows my condition. Only the flower does not know, though the whole garden does.

sher.hi:
इब्तिदा-ए-इश्क़ है रोता है क्या
आगे आगे देखिए होता है क्या
sher.roman:
Ibtidaa-e-ishq hai rota hai kya
Aage aage dekhiye hota hai kya
sher.en: It is only the beginning of love, so why cry? Just wait and see what happens next.

sher.hi:
दिखाई दिए यूँ कि बे-ख़ुद किया
हमें आप से भी जुदा कर चले
sher.roman:
Dikhaai diye yun ki be-khud kiya
Hamen aap se bhi juda kar chale
sher.en: The beloved appeared in such a way that I lost myself, and left me separated even from my own self.

sher.hi:
सितारों से आगे जहाँ और भी हैं
अभी इश्क़ के इम्तिहाँ और भी हैं
sher.roman:
Sitaaron se aage jahaan aur bhi hain
Abhi ishq ke imtihaan aur bhi hain
sher.en: There are more worlds beyond the stars, and there are more tests of love still to come.

sher.hi:
ख़ुदी को कर बुलंद इतना कि हर तक़दीर से पहले
ख़ुदा बंदे से ख़ुद पूछे बता तेरी रज़ा क्या है
sher.roman:
Khudi ko kar buland itna ki har taqdeer se pehle
Khuda bande se khud poochhe bata teri raza kya hai
sher.en: Raise your self-belief so high that, before every decree of destiny, God Himself asks you: tell me, what is your wish?

sher.hi:
लब पे आती है दुआ बन के तमन्ना मेरी
ज़िंदगी शम्अ की सूरत हो ख़ुदाया मेरी
sher.roman:
Lab pe aati hai dua ban ke tamanna meri
Zindagi shama ki soorat ho Khudaya meri
sher.en: My wish comes to my lips as a prayer: O God, may my life be like a candle.

sher.hi:
और भी दुख हैं ज़माने में मोहब्बत के सिवा
राहतें और भी हैं वस्ल की राहत के सिवा
sher.roman:
Aur bhi dukh hain zamaane mein mohabbat ke siwa
Raahaten aur bhi hain wasl ki raahat ke siwa
sher.en: There are other sorrows in the world besides love, and other comforts besides the comfort of being together.

sher.hi:
गुलों में रंग भरे बाद-ए-नौ-बहार चले
चले भी आओ कि गुलशन का कारोबार चले
sher.roman:
Gulon mein rang bhare baad-e-nau-bahaar chale
Chale bhi aao ki gulshan ka kaarobaar chale
sher.en: Let the fresh spring breeze blow and fill the flowers with colour. Come now, so that the garden's work can go on.

sher.hi:
रंजिश ही सही दिल ही दुखाने के लिए आ
आ फिर से मुझे छोड़ के जाने के लिए आ
sher.roman:
Ranjish hi sahi dil hi dukhaane ke liye aa
Aa phir se mujhe chhod ke jaane ke liye aa
sher.en: Be angry if you must, but come, even just to hurt my heart. Come again, even if only to leave me once more.

sher.hi:
अब के हम बिछड़े तो शायद कभी ख़्वाबों में मिलें
जिस तरह सूखे हुए फूल किताबों में मिलें
sher.roman:
Ab ke hum bichhde to shaayad kabhi khwaabon mein milen
Jis tarah sookhe hue phool kitaabon mein milen
sher.en: If we part now, perhaps we will meet only in dreams, the way dried flowers are found inside books.

sher.hi:
मैं सच कहूँगी मगर फिर भी हार जाऊँगी
वो झूठ बोलेगा और ला-जवाब कर देगा
sher.roman:
Main sach kahoongi magar phir bhi haar jaaungi
Woh jhooth bolega aur laa-jawaab kar dega
sher.en: I will speak the truth, yet I will still lose. He will tell a lie and leave me with no reply.

sher.hi:
उस गली ने ये सुन के सब्र किया
जाने वाले यहाँ के थे ही नहीं
sher.roman:
Us gali ne ye sun ke sabr kiya
Jaane waale yahaan ke the hi nahin
sher.en: The street comforted itself on hearing this: the ones who left never really belonged here.

sher.hi:
क्या तकल्लुफ़ करें ये कहने में
जो भी ख़ुश है हम उस से जलते हैं
sher.roman:
Kya takalluf karen ye kehne mein
Jo bhi khush hai hum us se jalte hain
sher.en: Why be formal about saying it: I envy everyone who is happy.

sher.hi:
सभी का ख़ून है शामिल यहाँ की मिट्टी में
किसी के बाप का हिंदोस्तान थोड़ी है
sher.roman:
Sabhi ka khoon hai shaamil yahaan ki mitti mein
Kisi ke baap ka Hindostaan thodi hai
sher.en: Everyone's blood is mixed into the soil of this land. India does not belong to any one person.

sher.hi:
अगर ख़िलाफ़ हैं होने दो जान थोड़ी है
ये सब धुआँ है कोई आसमान थोड़ी है
sher.roman:
Agar khilaaf hain hone do jaan thodi hai
Ye sab dhuaan hai koi aasmaan thodi hai
sher.en: If they are against me, let them be; they are not my life. This is all smoke, not the sky.

sher.hi:
आदतन तुम ने कर दिए वादे
आदतन हम ने ऐतबार किया
sher.roman:
Aadatan tum ne kar diye waade
Aadatan hum ne aitbaar kiya
sher.en: Out of habit you made promises, and out of habit I believed them.

sher.hi:
बुरा जो देखन मैं चला, बुरा न मिलिया कोय
जो दिल खोजा आपना, मुझसे बुरा न कोय
sher.roman:
Bura jo dekhan main chala, bura na miliya koi
Jo dil khoja aapna, mujh se bura na koi
sher.en: I set out to find the wicked, but I found no one. When I looked into my own heart, no one was worse than me.

sher.hi:
कुछ तो मजबूरियाँ रही होंगी
यूँ कोई बेवफ़ा नहीं होता
sher.roman:
Kuchh to majbooriyaan rahi hongi
Yun koi bewafa nahin hota
sher.en: There must have been some compulsions. No one is unfaithful for no reason.

sher.hi:
उजाले अपनी यादों के हमारे साथ रहने दो
न जाने किस गली में ज़िंदगी की शाम हो जाए
sher.roman:
Ujaale apni yaadon ke hamaare saath rehne do
Na jaane kis gali mein zindagi ki shaam ho jaaye
sher.en: Let the light of your memories stay with me. Who knows in which street the evening of life may fall.

sher.hi:
ख़ूब पर्दा है कि चिलमन से लगे बैठे हैं
साफ़ छुपते भी नहीं सामने आते भी नहीं
sher.roman:
Khoob parda hai ki chilman se lage baithe hain
Saaf chhupte bhi nahin saamne aate bhi nahin
sher.en: What a fine veil! The beloved sits right behind the screen, neither clearly hiding nor coming forward.

sher.hi:
कभी किसी को मुकम्मल जहाँ नहीं मिलता
कहीं ज़मीन तो कहीं आसमाँ नहीं मिलता
sher.roman:
Kabhi kisi ko mukammal jahaan nahin milta
Kahin zameen to kahin aasmaan nahin milta
sher.en: No one ever gets a complete world. Somewhere the earth is missing, and somewhere the sky.

sher.hi:
रहिमन धागा प्रेम का, मत तोड़ो चटकाय
टूटे से फिर ना जुड़े, जुड़े गाँठ परि जाय
sher.roman:
Rahiman dhaaga prem ka, mat todo chatkaay
Toote se phir na jude, jude gaanth pari jaay
sher.en: The thread of love should not be snapped carelessly. Once it breaks it does not join again, and if it does join, a knot remains.

sher.hi:
पोथी पढ़ि पढ़ि जग मुआ, पंडित भया न कोय
ढाई आखर प्रेम का, पढ़े सो पंडित होय
sher.roman:
Pothi padhi padhi jag mua, pandit bhaya na koy
Dhai aakhar prem ka, padhe so pandit hoy
sher.en: The world died reading books again and again, yet no one became truly wise. Whoever learns the two and a half letters of love becomes a real scholar.

sher.hi:
काल करे सो आज कर, आज करे सो अब
पल में परलय होएगी, बहुरि करेगा कब
sher.roman:
Kaal kare so aaj kar, aaj kare so ab
Pal mein parlay hoyegi, bahuri karega kab
sher.en: Do tomorrow's work today, and today's work right now. Disaster can strike in a moment, so when will you ever do it?

sher.hi:
गुरु गोविंद दोऊ खड़े, काके लागूं पाँय
बलिहारी गुरु आपने, गोविंद दियो बताय
sher.roman:
Guru Govind dou khade, kake laagun paay
Balihaari Guru aapne, Govind diyo bataay
sher.en: The teacher and God both stand before me. Whose feet should I touch first? I bow to my teacher, who showed me the way to God.

basics: A two-line poem that holds one complete idea. Each line is called a 'misra'.
A poem made of shers that follow the same rhyme pattern, each sher standing on its own.
The first sher of a ghazal (matla) and the last sher, which usually carries the poet's pen-name (maqta).
Qafia is the rhyming word; radif is the phrase that repeats after it at the end of each line.
A poem on one theme from beginning to end, like a story or a letter.
A two-line rhyming verse of wisdom, popular in Hindi, such as Kabir's.

quotes.author: Steve Jobs
quotes.en: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
quotes.hindi: बेहतरीन काम करने का एक ही तरीका है: जो काम करो, उससे प्यार करो।
quotes.simple: You will do your best work when you enjoy what you do.

quotes.author: Nelson Mandela
quotes.en: It always seems impossible until it's done.
quotes.hindi: जब तक कोई काम हो नहीं जाता, वह असंभव ही लगता है।
quotes.simple: Hard things look impossible at first, but they look possible once someone has done them.

quotes.author: Confucius
quotes.en: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
quotes.hindi: आप कितना धीरे चलते हैं, यह मायने नहीं रखता, बस रुकना नहीं चाहिए।
quotes.simple: Slow progress is still progress. Just keep going.

quotes.author: Japanese proverb
quotes.en: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
quotes.hindi: सात बार गिरो, आठ बार उठो।
quotes.simple: Failing is normal. What counts is that you get up again.

quotes.author: Wayne Gretzky
quotes.en: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
quotes.hindi: जो शॉट आप लगाते ही नहीं, उनमें से 100% चूक जाते हैं।
quotes.simple: If you never try, you can never succeed.

quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt
quotes.en: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
quotes.hindi: मान लो कि तुम कर सकते हो, तो आधा रास्ता पार हो गया।
quotes.simple: Self-belief is the first and biggest step.
words: at the middle of the way

quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin
quotes.en: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
quotes.hindi: ज्ञान में लगाया गया निवेश सबसे अच्छा ब्याज देता है।
quotes.simple: Time and money spent on learning give you the biggest return.
words: money or time put in to gain later

quotes.author: Nelson Mandela
quotes.en: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
quotes.hindi: शिक्षा सबसे शक्तिशाली हथियार है जिससे आप दुनिया को बदल सकते हैं।
quotes.simple: Learning gives people the power to make the world better.

quotes.author: B. B. King
quotes.en: The beautiful thing about learning is that no one can take it away from you.
quotes.hindi: सीखने की खूबसूरती यह है कि उसे आपसे कोई छीन नहीं सकता।
quotes.simple: Money can be lost, but what you have learned stays with you.

quotes.author: Dr. Seuss
quotes.en: The more that you read, the more things you will know. The more that you learn, the more places you'll go.
quotes.hindi: जितना ज़्यादा पढ़ोगे, उतना ज़्यादा जानोगे। जितना ज़्यादा सीखोगे, उतनी ज़्यादा जगहें देखोगे।
quotes.simple: Reading and learning open up new worlds for you.
words: as one grows, so does the other

quotes.author: Robert Collier
quotes.en: Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
quotes.hindi: सफलता उन छोटी-छोटी कोशिशों का जोड़ है जो हर दिन दोहराई जाती हैं।
quotes.simple: Small steps taken every day add up to big success.

quotes.author: William Shakespeare
quotes.en: Love all, trust a few, do wrong to none.
quotes.hindi: सबसे प्यार करो, कुछ पर भरोसा करो, किसी के साथ बुरा मत करो।
quotes.simple: Be kind to everyone, keep a small circle you trust, and never harm anyone.

quotes.author: David Viscott
quotes.en: To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
quotes.hindi: प्यार करना और प्यार पाना, दोनों तरफ़ से धूप महसूस करने जैसा है।
quotes.simple: Giving love and receiving love together feel warm and complete.

quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi
quotes.en: Where there is love there is life.
quotes.hindi: जहाँ प्यार है, वहाँ जीवन है।
quotes.simple: Life is full and alive when there is love in it.

quotes.author: Rumi
quotes.en: The wound is the place where the light enters you.
quotes.hindi: घाव वही जगह है जहाँ से रोशनी भीतर आती है।
quotes.simple: Our pain can open us to wisdom and healing.

quotes.author: Maya Angelou
quotes.en: There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you.
quotes.hindi: अपने भीतर किसी अनकही कहानी को ढोने से बड़ी पीड़ा कोई नहीं।
quotes.simple: Keeping an important story to yourself hurts deeply. Sharing it brings relief.
words: to carry, to put up with

quotes.author: Carl Jung
quotes.en: Even a happy life cannot be without a measure of darkness.
quotes.hindi: सबसे खुशहाल जीवन में भी थोड़ा अँधेरा ज़रूर होता है।
quotes.simple: Every life has some sad times, and they help us value the happy ones.

quotes.author: John Lennon
quotes.en: Life is what happens when you're busy making other plans.
quotes.hindi: जब आप दूसरी योजनाएँ बनाने में व्यस्त होते हैं, तब जीवन घट रहा होता है।
quotes.simple: Real life happens while we are planning. Enjoy the present too.
words: an idea of what to do

quotes.author: J. R. R. Tolkien
quotes.en: Not all those who wander are lost.
quotes.hindi: भटकने वाले सभी लोग खोए हुए नहीं होते।
quotes.simple: Someone who explores or takes a different road may know exactly what they are doing.

quotes.author: Walter Winchell
quotes.en: A real friend is one who walks in when the rest of the world walks out.
quotes.hindi: सच्चा दोस्त वह है जो तब आता है जब बाकी दुनिया चली जाती है।
quotes.simple: A true friend stays with you when everyone else leaves.
